Subject: Workday supplier invite: token mismatch when company name contains '&'

Hi Rebecca,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Quick summary: we sent a Workday supplier activation invite to the procurement contact you shared (Tom). When Tom clicks the activation link the page returns an "Invalid activation token" error. He can reproduce it repeatedly.

We noticed the company display name in AtlasCo's profile includes an ampersand ("Atlas & Sons") and our initial hypothesis is the ampersand is getting HTML-encoded in the invite URL ("&") which breaks token parsing on Workday's side.

Could you confirm:
- Which email Tom used to click the invite (helpful to match logs)
- A quick screenshot of the browser error if possible (I've attached a screenshot we captured)

Action plan from our side: I've looped in Ben and Karthik from onboarding to triage. If it's an encoding issue we'll push a gateway fix and resend the invite.

Attachments: screenshot-activation-error.png (screenshot of the error page)

Thanks,

On Sun, Apr 25, 2027 at 9:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> We noticed the company display name in AtlasCo's profile includes an ampersand ("Atlas & Sons") and our initial hypothesis is the ampersand is getting HTML-encoded in the invite URL ("&") which breaks token parsing on Workday's side.

Quick note from me: this reads exactly like a URL-encoding edge case at the gateway layer where we build the redirect URL. I've seen a similar symptom when query params were escaped twice and the token parser on the partner side treats the encoded ampersand as part of the token value.

Plan:
- Karthik, can you open an urgent SUP ticket to SRE and add SUP-1823 (I've linked the draft) so we can prioritize?
- Laura, I'll coordinate with Atlas to test a resend once SRE deploys a fix.

Rebecca/Tom — apologies for the hassle. We'll aim to have a fix and a reissued invite within the day.

Ben Carter

Subject: RE: Workday supplier invite: token mismatch when company name contains '&' — update

Hi all,

On Sun, 25 Apr 2027 at 11:00 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note from me: this reads exactly like a URL-encoding edge case at the gateway layer where we build the redirect URL.

Update from engineering and SRE: we confirmed the gateway was double-escaping query strings when a profile field contained characters that require HTML escaping (ampersand, less-than/greater-than). The double-escape turned "&" into "%26" and then into "%2526" in the final redirect, which made Workday treat the token as invalid.

What we did:
- Deployed a targeted fix to the invite-generation path to normalize/percent-encode only once.
- Added a regression test that includes display names with the following characters: & < > " ' /
- Re-issued the invite to tom.harris@atlasco.com at 15:25 PDT (you should have a new email from no-reply@redwood.com).

Attachments: release-notes-2027-04-26.md (short changelog)

Rebecca/Tom — can you confirm Tom is able to accept the new invite? If there are any residual errors please paste the full URL he clicked (we will not log tokens in public threads but will use it to reproduce in staging).

Thanks for the quick repro and patience.

Regards,
